label: Google Sheets: On New Row
description: Fires once per row added to a tab. Activation starts from the sheet's current end (history never replays), the position survives restarts, and each new row fires with its cells, the header-keyed object, and its sheet row number.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: A Google account with write access to the sheet (the picker grant covers the file it picked).

inputs.name: spreadsheet
inputs.label: Spreadsheet
inputs.placeholder: Pick one, or paste its share link

inputs.name: tab
inputs.label: Tab
inputs.placeholder: Pick a tab, or paste a link with #gid=

inputs.name: intervalSecs
inputs.label: Check every (seconds)
inputs.description: How often the sheet is checked for new rows.

inputs.name: hasHeader
inputs.label: First row is a header
inputs.description: Needed to order an object row's columns.

outputs.name: row
outputs.description: The new row keyed by the header (positional c0, c1, ... without one).

outputs.name: cells
outputs.description: The new row's raw cells in order.

outputs.name: rowNumber
outputs.description: The new row's 1-based sheet row number.
